economicIdentification.acceptanceQualification: Acceptance means complete customer handoff under the frozen independent checker. An auxiliary Workbench fullTask captured-source reference had one too few parent path components at trial time. The identical delivery/raw-task.json exists and customer-report references resolve. Any publication navigation aliases are post-outcome repairs, not successful trial links or semantic reruns; no quality, cost or effort premium is credited.
economicIdentification.boundary: Four complete customer handoffs under the frozen checker qualify this A/B diagnostic. This does not claim every auxiliary Workbench link was valid at trial time, field reliability, customer demand, human effort savings, billing or superiority over a strong fully qualified conventional provider.
